name: NRS Skelton Gloves-L/XL
description: NRS Skelton Gloves - The Skelton Gloves by NRS provide complete sun protection and improved grip without overheating your hands or limiting your dexterity. These ultralight fingerless fishing gloves are made of NRS' H2Core Rashguard material so they breathe freely, wick moisture away, and deliver UPF 50+ protection from the sun's harmful rays. They have an open-finger design allowing maximum dexterity for tying on flies and lures, and there are Amara synthetic leather patches on the 1st and 2nd fingers to take the abrasion while you are stripping line. Silicone dots on palms provide excellent grip, while pairing snaps on the cuffs help you keep the gloves together. The fish are calling you, so grab your NRS Skelton Gloves and hit the water.
